image_prompt: A portly, anthropomorphic dodo bird with exaggerated Victorian-era features. The dodo has a large, curved beak and beady eyes with a monocle perched on one eye. Its plumage is a mix of soft grays and whites, with vibrant splashes of blue and green in impossible patterns. The dodo wears an ornate, oversized top hat adorned with pocket watches and tea cups. It sports a red velvet waistcoat with gold buttons, stretched tightly over its rotund belly. A pair of comically small wings protrude from its sides, barely visible beneath a voluminous tailcoat. The dodo's legs are spindly and disproportionately long, ending in absurdly large, bright yellow webbed feet. It holds a golden pocket watch in one wing and a rolled-up scroll in the other, emphasizing its self-important demeanor.
